name: @aipm/pr-description-writer
description: Turn a diff, ticket, and test notes into a clear, reviewer-ready pull request description.
usage: Use after staging changes or opening a branch for review. Provide the diff and any ticket context; ask the skill to draft the PR description before you open the PR.
agentDescription: Use this skill when a diff or set of staged/branch changes is ready for review and needs a pull request description. It groups changes by intent rather than by file, separates what changed from why, requires test-plan claims to be backed by actually-run commands or observed behavior, and calls out risky changes (hot-path behavior changes, schema/migration changes, new external calls) explicitly rather than with generic hedging.

examples.title: Draft a PR description from a diff
examples.description: Generate a summary/changes/test-plan description from `git diff main...HEAD` and the linked ticket.
examples.prompt: Here's my diff against main and the ticket it closes. Write a PR description using the pr-description-writer format.

examples.title: Flag risk in a behavior-changing PR
examples.description: Surface risky changes a reviewer needs to know about before approving.
examples.prompt: Use pr-description-writer on this diff and make sure any risky or behavior-changing parts are called out clearly.
